Case: Mayra is a 45-year-old with hepatocellular carcinoma status-post C4-C5 corpectomy and fusion 8 months ago who presents with new arm and leg pain. MRI of scans of her entire spine show increased tumor burden in her lumbar and cervical spine causing multiple areas of severe stenosis. You are also able to identify new lesions seeding her peritoneum.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Mayra? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
